Obserra Advisor FAB + panel work and return grounded answers (e.g., correctly enumerated SAP_ALL holders).
critical_code_review_comments: sap_uac.py is 1642 lines — consider splitting into modules (identities, sod, activation, hr, requests, certifications, advisor) for maintainability per >700 lines guideline.
Certification decide endpoint expects exact case 'Certify'/'Revoke' — consider case-insensitive to avoid client bugs.
Activation payload uses 'person_refs' (list) — good. Frontend already sends list; document API contract clearly.
